green-onion.label: Green onion
green-onion.note: Use the deep green tops for garnish. Slice the white base and stir-fry it early with the aromatics — it holds a stronger onion bite than the greens.

soy-sauce.label: Soy sauce
soy-sauce.note: Pour it around the edge of the pan, not directly on the rice — it hits the hot metal and caramelizes slightly before mixing in.

garlic.label: Garlic
garlic.note: Add it after the onions, not before — garlic burns fast and turns bitter if it hits hot oil first.

sesame-oil.label: Sesame oil
sesame-oil.note: This is a finishing oil, not a cooking oil. Stir it in off the heat at the very end so the aroma doesn't cook off.
